class.name: TerrainMesh
class.description: [TerrainMesh] generates an upward-facing triangulated heightfield from a rectangular grid of floating-point heights. It can be assigned directly to [member MeshInstance3D.mesh], and automatically rebuilds its geometry after edits. Heights are stored in a row-major array (X first, then Z). A grid position [code]Vector2(x, z)[/code] selects the sample at horizontal coordinate [code]x * cell_size[/code] and depth coordinate [code]z * cell_size[/code]. The rendered Y coordinate is the stored height multiplied by [member height_scale]. Use [method sculpt] to raise or lower terrain, [method smooth] to reduce abrupt height changes, or [method erode] for basic thermal erosion. All brush positions and radii are specified in grid cells, not world units. When 3D physics is enabled, use a [TerrainCollision3D] node to generate a matching static collider that automatically follows resource edits. [b]Note:[/b] This is a basic single-mesh terrain resource. It does not yet implement chunk streaming, LOD, texture painting, or asynchronous collision baking.

method.name: erode
method.description: Applies a simple volume-conserving thermal erosion pass [param iterations] times. Material above the [param talus] height difference flows toward lower orthogonal neighbors. [param strength] must be between [code]0[/code] and [code]1[/code].

method.name: get_height
method.description: Returns the stored unscaled height at grid coordinate ([param x], [param z]).

method.name: sample_height
method.description: Returns a bilinearly interpolated unscaled height. Positions outside the grid clamp to its edges.

method.name: sculpt
method.description: Raises or lowers heights inside a circular brush, with linear distance falloff. Positive [param amount] raises the terrain; negative [param amount] lowers it. The [param radius] is measured in grid cells and must be positive.

method.name: set_height
method.description: Assigns the unscaled height of a single grid vertex. The height must be finite.

method.name: smooth
method.description: Blends heights in the specified brush radius toward their original 3-by-3 neighborhood average. [param strength] must be between [code]0[/code] and [code]1[/code].

members.member: The positive X/Z world spacing between adjacent grid samples.
Grid dimensions in vertices, including both edges. Each dimension must be between 2 and 1024. Resizing retains overlapping previous samples and initializes new samples to zero.
The positive multiplier applied to stored heights to obtain rendered Y coordinates.
Row-major height samples. Its length must equal [code]grid_size.x * grid_size.y[/code]. Individual samples may be negative, but all must be finite.
